protocol.event_definition: 12–13 January 2020 main mapped fallout; published 13:00–04:28 local, endpoint-definition uncertainty retained
evaluation_rules: Independent inputs preferred; no evaluation-data tuning
70/30 spatial-group split only if calibration necessary; duplicate/dependency families intact
1–21 km geopotential wind grid; 75% coverage; no extrapolation
Interval RMSE/MAE and midpoint RMSE/MAE separate; 0.5 mm footprint IoU requires accepted geometry
protocol.acceptance_tolerance: No defensible predictive tolerance established; descriptive agreement only when inputs become usable

source_dependencies.disclosure: These quantities derive from the same observations; contour vertices and inferred input fits are not independent evaluation evidence.

assessment_reasons: Independent QA approved frozen methodology; scientific input gate remains blocked
Published 8,605 km² narrative and 3,864.89 km² Table 3 area statements remain distinct unresolved references
No participant or classroom empirical study was performed
Numerical verification does not establish empirical accuracy
blocked_inputs: Tanay selected-launch coverage 71.43% below frozen 75% requirement
Reviewed active 2020 vent height datum (the GVP 311 m profile is not an active-vent survey)
Independent ash mass and dry bulk density
Whole-event grain fractions and settling speeds
Raw geolocated thickness observations and defensible original measurement/interpolation uncertainty
2020 census coverage beyond 34 Batangas records and historical boundary crosswalk review
Condition-specific roof/crop thresholds and water-facility coordinates
Resolve/report published footprint area definitions without target selection
